screens.title: Inventory tray
screens.description: A small set of tactile item tokens stays distinct from the scene and supports inspect, select, combine, and cancel.

screens.title: Item interaction
screens.description: A selected item and target form a clear contextual action with feedback about a plausible or rejected use.

screens.title: Dialogue scene
screens.description: A character-forward line, expression cue, and a small response set sit over a mostly open painted scene.
